categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches test_runner.py only to register a new wallet-specific functional test.
categories.rationale: The change to test_runner.py merely registers a new test for wallet chain state updates, which belongs to wallet rather than test infrastructure.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp to defer transaction state evaluation to AttachChain.
categories.rationale: Fixes an assertion failure (`!wtx.isConfirmed()`) and prevents confirmed transactions from being incorrectly marked abandoned during wallet loading. According to the description and linked issue #34599, evaluating transaction states against the chain prior to AttachChain can miss intermediate blocks, leaving wallet state inconsistent and crashing the node.
